text:
Sophia L.: @everyone quick sync — we need a lift-and-shift capacity staging plan for the upcoming marketplace onramp. target: customers moving from H100 to mixed H200/B200 and MI300/Gaudi fallbacks. timeline constraints from partners: 2–4 weeks for driver certs. who can own the handoff runbook?
Alex M.: I can take runbook + canary checklist. will need SI contact for testbeds.
Mike R.: Heads up — lab slots are tight week of Oct 9. can we stagger canaries by region? :thinking_face:
Jen K.: Staggering sounds right. suggest: APAC -> EMEA -> NA for least customer impact. also need embargo windows from partners.
Nikhil H.: From HW team: Gaudi images are green but perf varies under long-context. MI300 firmware update lands next Tue — expect slight mem changes. embargo window request: 48h for joint press.
Ravi P.: Partner ops: we can support a 72h preannounce embargo handshake. need a firm cutover date + model compatibility matrix before we lock PR.
Sophia L.: OK combine asks: 1) runbook owner = Alex 2) canary cadence = region-staggered 3) partner embargo = 72h pref 4) fallback mapping for low-capacity = B200/quantized MI300.
Alex M.: Draft runbook snippets:
```
canary_phase:
  phase1: apac-us-west-edge
  phase2: emea-central
  phase3: na-east
fallback_policy:
  primary: h200
  fallback1: h100 (if available)
  fallback2: b200-quantized
monitoring: latency_p90 < 120ms, error_rate < 0.5%
```
Mike R.: Love that. Add: lab tag `staging-handoff-3112` so infra reserves GPUs. I'll book two H200 nodes for phase1.
Jen K.: Can we add a short checklist for SI integration? e.g., keys, network peering, cert thumbprints, sample inference test.
Alex M.: Yup — SI checklist (one-liner items) included in draft. will push to the partnership repo by EOD.
Nikhil H.: Testing note: MI300 quant runs need different kernel flags. I'll drop the kernel flag matrix in the PR.
Ravi P.: For marketplace listing — marketing needs approx. 5 business days after embargo lift to prepare copy. keep that in the timeline.
ops-bot: Reminder: create incident channel `#release-handoff-3112345678` once runbook is published.
Sophia L.: Action items: Alex publish runbook + checklist by EOD, Mike reserve lab slots for Oct 9+11, Nikhil publish kernel flag matrix, Ravi confirm embargo exact window (72h ok), Jen prep SI one-pager for partners.
Alex M.: Will do. tagging @Ravi P. for embargo confirmation. :thumbsup:
Ravi P.: Confirmed 72h. propose tentative public cutover Nov 3, internal canaries start Oct 16.
Mike R.: Confirmed lab reservations for Oct 16 canary phase.
Jen K.: I'll draft SI one-pager and ping SIs for preflight on Oct 12.
Nikhil H.: Kernel flags and perf notes posted to PR #4512.
Alex M.: Runbook PR created: https://git.internal/repo/partnerships/runbooks/pull/78 — please review.
Sophia L.: Great — once PR lands, ops-bot create channel and notify partners. thanks everyone. :rocket:
